title: Zero to RAG (Google as Embedding Provider)

cues.en: Hi, in this companion video we are going to use Google as embedding provider instead of OpenAI and Azure OpenAI.
cues.zh: 大家好，這支補充影片要把嵌入模型供應商從 OpenAI 或 Azure OpenAI，改成 Google。

cues.en: We are in this sample going to base it on the one we did for the Azure OpenAI in the main video with in-memory,
cues.zh: 這個範例會以主影片中使用 Azure OpenAI 搭配 InMemory 的版本為基礎，

cues.en: but of course Google can work with all the other vector stores as well.
cues.zh: 但當然，Google 也能搭配其他向量儲存區。

cues.en: It's just so it's easy for us to understand what we're changing.
cues.zh: 這樣做只是為了讓我們更容易看出修改了哪些地方。

cues.en: So in the code I have ripped out our embedding generator,
cues.zh: 程式碼中，我已經移除原本的嵌入生成器，

cues.en: so we don't have that anymore and we don't have a client that can go in and make an agent, because we want to switch to Google.
cues.zh: 所以目前沒有嵌入生成器，也沒有能建立代理程式的用戶端，因為我們要改用 Google。

cues.en: In order to do that of course we need a Google API key, we need their embedding model and some kind of LLM model.
cues.zh: 為此，當然需要 Google API 金鑰、Google 的嵌入模型，以及一個 LLM 模型。

cues.en: So up here in Google's documentation we can find different models,
cues.zh: 到 Google 文件中，可以找到不同模型，

cues.en: so for example we want to use Gemini 3.6 Flash here for our LLM.
cues.zh: 例如，這裡想使用 Gemini 3.6 Flash 作為 LLM。

cues.en: So we put that in as the LLM model and further down here we have embeddings, where we can find that it's called Gemini Embedding 2.
cues.zh: 把它填入 LLM 模型設定，再往下看 Embeddings，可以找到名稱是 Gemini Embedding 2。

cues.en: Gemini's embedding models go from 15, 36 and up to more dimensions than OpenAI does.
cues.zh: Gemini 的嵌入模型可以從 1,536 維開始，支援比 OpenAI 這裡使用的模型更多的維度。

cues.en: It means it can work with some more multiple dimensions.
cues.zh: 也就是能用更多維度表示資料。

cues.en: OpenAI have their text large that can do the same, but that means that certain vector stores cannot fit that many dimensions,
cues.zh: OpenAI 的大型文字嵌入模型也能做到類似的事，但某些向量儲存區無法容納那麼多維度，

cues.en: all depending on their capabilities.
cues.zh: 要看它們各自的能力。

cues.en: But in this case we're using in-memory so it's easy, but just bear in mind, test out if your vector store actually supports
cues.zh: 這裡使用 InMemory，所以比較容易。但要記得，必須先確認向量儲存區是否支援，

cues.en: that amount of dimensions or not.
cues.zh: 模型輸出的維度數量。

cues.en: Let's move on to finding our API key, and I'm going to make a new API key here in Google AI Studio,
cues.zh: 接著取得 API 金鑰。我會在 Google AI Studio 裡建立一把新的金鑰，

cues.en: and this API key will be gone once you see this video, so there's no harm in me sharing it with you here.
cues.zh: 等你看到影片時，這把金鑰就已經刪除了，所以這裡展示沒有關係。

cues.en: So we take that and we put it in here.
cues.zh: 取得後，把它貼到這裡。

cues.en: Now we need some new NuGet packages, so we need the Google GenAI, the official NuGet package to run.
cues.zh: 現在需要新的 NuGet 套件，也就是 Google 官方的 Google.GenAI。

cues.en: So run that,
cues.zh: 安裝它，

cues.en: and download it, and in order for us to work with Microsoft Agent Framework, we of course also need that itself,
cues.zh: 下載完成後，要使用 Microsoft Agent Framework，當然也需要它本身的套件，

cues.en: so we're installing that.
cues.zh: 所以一併安裝。

cues.en: Then we need to create our embedding generator, and luckily it's very simple.
cues.zh: 接著建立嵌入生成器，幸好這很簡單。

cues.en: We just simply say new Google.genai.clients, and in that we can set a bunch of things,
cues.zh: 只要建立新的 Google.GenAI.Client。它可以設定很多選項，

cues.en: but the only thing we need to set is the API key, and then we have a client, and with that client we can simply say
cues.zh: 但這裡唯一需要設定的是 API 金鑰。取得用戶端之後，就能直接呼叫，

cues.en: as embedding generator with the model, so the embedding model name,
cues.zh: AsEmbeddingGenerator，傳入模型，也就是嵌入模型的名稱，

cues.en: which we found up in the documentation, and when we do that, we get our embedding generator that we need down here.
cues.zh: 使用剛才文件裡找到的名稱，就能取得下方程式所需的嵌入生成器。

cues.en: We get our client that can then turn it into an AI client,
cues.zh: 接著，這個用戶端也能轉成 AI 用戶端。

cues.en: and that's everything else we need compared to what we did in Azure, and again, it's just an in-memory system now,
cues.zh: 相較於先前的 Azure 版本，修改內容就只有這些。再次提醒，目前仍是 InMemory 系統，

cues.en: but we can embed now doing it using Google services and Azure OpenAI,
cues.zh: 但現在可以改用 Google 服務，而不是 Azure OpenAI，來產生嵌入向量。

cues.en: and once we're done, we get an answer back from Gemini that the office password is still guest 42, and that's everything there is to it.
cues.zh: 完成後，Gemini 會回傳答案：辦公室密碼還是 guest42。全部就是這樣。

cues.en: Again, we can just mix and match providers and vector stores with the caveat that Google makes not 1536 dimensions,
cues.zh: 再次提醒，供應商與向量儲存區可以自由搭配，只要注意，Google 這裡輸出的不是 1,536 維，

cues.en: but the double, but that's everything.
cues.zh: 而是兩倍的維度。除此之外就沒有其他差異。

cues.en: See you in the next one.
cues.zh: 我們下一支影片再見。
